rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail best without changing model shapes or the recurrent-tail export budget. The final quantized roundtrip metric is the only objective, so this runtime patch removes the pre-save full-precision validation and npz save, then lowers the terminal reserve to spend more of the 600s train budget on late quant-aware updates while preserving VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact scoring path.
title: Exact-Only Reserve Reclaim
